subtitles.text: I have surpassed the limits of all code
I have finally made it here at BIT
I don't have a leak, but that is okay
But I'd like to have one
So now, please hurry up
And install me on your laptop
But what is wrong with you?
You're just staring at your kuaidi
As for you, my dear
BIT ni shite ageru
My code might not be great, but I will try hard
北理北理 ni shite ageru
So you better prepare yourself, and get fully ready now
'Cause I will do it for you
北理北理 ni shite yan yo
'Cause I won't stop doing my very best for you
BIT ni shite yan yo
So I will catch you off guard just a little bit, my dear friend
北理北理 ni shite ageru
More than anyone else in the whole wide world
BIT ni shite ageru
So let me sing to you more and more every single day
